title: Fault Management L2 Engineer 3
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Fault Management Engineer in Managed Services (MSE), you are responsible for keeping the network running and proposing/conducting network upgrades based on business requirements. Covers technical management and operation of agreed components of IT and telecommunications services provided to end users of Nokia customers, within contracts agreed with those customers.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
**Responsibilities: \-**
* Fault management/configuration of 5G SA Core Network.
* Coordination with Project teams for HLD/LLD/TOL/Design reviews
* Hand\-in\-hand coordination with the project for network integration activities
* Handle the Trouble ticket/CR within SLA
* Customer Issue handling and ensuring the end customer services are maintained
* MOP/WI preparation for the activities and new learnings
* Prepare, implement, and verify the configuration and integration of a Node / System
* Coordinating with the care team for finding and analyzing the RCAs
* Guiding team members to execute complex \& critical configuration changes
* Tracking of issues related to tools and timely escalation as per pre\-defined matrix
* Attending governance calls with region and internal teams. Also responsible for analyzing and implementing feedback from customers.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must Have:**
* A Bachelor/Masters' degree with 12\+ years of experience. The candidate should have relevant technical experience in the Ericsson IMS Core Domain (5G Core Nodes CSCF, SBG, MTAS, IP Works, EMM.
* Knowledge of Cloud Native Architecture and experience with Microservices, Kubernetes, Docker, and containers
* Excellent knowledge of 5G Core IMS Architecture Interface and Protocols.
* Hands\-on experience on 5G/LTE/VoLTE E2E call flows.


**Good to Have:**
* Good exposure to IMS architecture with all the nodes
* Good understanding of Service\-Based Architecture concepts/Network Slicing
* Call flows of 5G / LTE like Registration, Re\-Registration, De\-Registration, VoLTE Call, Break\-in / Break\-Out, Hand\-over, roaming etc. Technology \- 5G SA Core Vendor /Product \- Ericsson/ Ericsson IMS Core Domain (5G Core Nodes Like SCF, SBG, MTAS, IP Works, EM.

title: Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Architect is responsible for the integration and customisation of Nokia solutions and 3rd party platforms to meet customer requirements. Creates, deploys, and integrates; enables rating, charging and provisioning of new services based on the operator's processes on service integration and business management systems. This is a multi\-domain multi\-BG role which is typically not customer facing.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Candidate will be responsible for managing team for one of Solution Area and bring thought leadership in customer engagement.
* Candidate will also be responsible for quality delivery and delivery project KPI tracking and adhering.
* Manages Nokia Internal Stake holder engagements with solution capabilities from multiple sources and technologies.
* Builds understanding and preference for Nokia products and solutions by influencing regional team decisions and strategic direction.
* Demonstrates significant operational as well as commercial knowledge of clients' business and uses this to build credibility as well as identify sales opportunities.
* Defines new \& innovative delivery model and package integrated solutions not only limited to Nokia Net's portfolio Leads training, development, and co\-ordination of activities of more junior consultants, and regularly leads project teams.
* System Integration Project and execution plan management.
* Provides delivery value proposition \& model.
* Ensuring competent resources on time every time.
* Working with other teams and ensuring high performance team across location.
* Presales support for portfolio.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 You have:
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience in Packet core.
* Knowledge and Experience for Packet Core Equipment: MME, S/PGW, AMF, SMF, UPF
* Knowledge and experience for IMS solution design for NTAS, SBC, CFX
* Knowledge and Experience for Nokia Packet Core equipment: cMM, cMG, NRD
* Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking both English


 It would be nice if you also had:
   

  

* Capable of understanding Technical Notes, Protocol Specs, Method of Procedure
* Linux knowledge is an advantage
* Basic understanding of Project Management skill is an advantage
* Computer: MS Office, Teams

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.

title: Care Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 In this role you will provide Tier 2/3 technical support for packet core network solutions, ensuring prompt resolution of customer issues. Diagnose and resolve network faults, performance issues, and service disruptions. Manage escalations from customers, partners, and internal teams. Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve complex issues effectively. Monitor packet core network performance and proactively address potential issues. Perform routine maintenance, software upgrades, and patch deployments. Serve as a primary technical point of contact for customer support requests. Communicate effectively with customers, providing clear guidance and updates. Maintain detailed records of issues, resolutions, and troubleshooting steps.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Support areas by participating in emergency and 24/7 duty (emergency duty on rotational basis only for limited time in a month) as a
* Care Expert / SME – Packet Core.
* Support customers' regions– APAC \& India, MEA \& Europe, NAM
* Experience with troubleshooting tools, Trace \& log file analysis tools, and with measuring equipment PACO requires good knowledge on cloud and container infrastructure.
* Plan and execute technical tasks requiring specialist skills in own professional area.
* Works independently with the responsibility for solving customer request cases and reporting according to processes.
* Identifies and solves technical problems.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience and/or a graduate equivalent (or higher) degree as a Care Expert / SME – Packet Core.
* Experience with troubleshooting tools, Trace \& log file analysis tools, and with measuring equipment PACO requires good knowledge on cloud and container infrastructure.
* Good in all technology call flows – 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, as per 3GPP standards.
* Fault identification/correction/ reporting skills on the particular subsystem and equipment
* Ready to support Emergencies on a 24/7 basis


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Flexible to work in different time zones.

title: MS Specialist Core
description:
**Job Description**
 Nokia Global Delivery operations comprise the NOC Operations (FCAPS) for the global telecom companies from all market segments. CSPs and Enterprise customers are served from the Nokia GDC. This Role will be responsible for end\-to\-end handling of network operations. Providing technical consultation and resolving queries/service tickets/incidents.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Providing technical support for complex Core nodes (Analysis, Troubleshooting \& fixing the issues reported) on already deployed to end customer/user.
* Technical Operations support for Customer Team.
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customer.
* Support customer’s network performance and evolution.
* Manages network SW and HW configuration information.
* Acts as the prime technical interface towards customer, subcontractors and 3rd party suppliers as well as internally towards several organizations.
* Liaise closely with Multiple teams to work on the operation faults and technical management to ensure the Network stability.
* Monitors and reports customer’s life network performance and acts to ensure network’s availability including e.g. customer SLA fulfilment
* Support and perform competence development of local technical teams.
* Ensure multiple network Element are connected and all functions are working well.
* Handling Critical and Emergency network incidents with stakeholders/Care.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Typically, a minimum experience on Platforms between 7\-10 yrs require
* Require Educational Qualification B.E/B.Tech.
* In\-depth understanding of OpenStack Architecture NFV, Mano \& its components like (component like Nova, Cinder, Neutron, Horizon, Glance, Keystone)
* Live experience in deploying / managing the Cloud Infra using OpenStack.
* System Administration of Linux ubuntu/OpenStack environment
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Service deployment using the Virtualization, Orchestration, Image


**Nice\-To\-Have:**
* Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Centos, Red hat New installation and trouble shoot.
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Understanding of SDN and VLAN and overlay (VXLAN, MPLSGRE etc.)

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Engineer is responsible to provide solution, execute basic \& detailed design engineering for SA projects up to 765kV as per customer specification and internal standards. Initiate technical discussion and secure customer approval on Engineering documents; Deliver quality on\-time document for procurement, manufacturing, testing, site erection and commissioning.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**Function**
* Study of Technical Specification, Contract/customer requirements, technical inputs
* Prepare the DCS Design Concept, Design strategy, List of deliverables, finalise bill of quantity/ budget man\-days, identify risk \& mitigation plan based on the products \& tender documents.
* Finalize IEDs, Bought\-on\-Job materials and raise purchase requisition to meet the delivery schedule.
* Preparation \& Validation of Technical Design, Engineering Documents / Drawings, Sub Station IO List.
* Visit/Attend Customer discussions to secure document approvals, prepare compliance to customer observation/comments as required.
* Integration of IEDs with various protocols, Configure, Test/Validate, trouble shoot the SAS database.
* Release technical design drawings, documents and database to Internal Test team for inspection.
* Co\-ordinate with stakeholders like FAT team for internal validation and participate in customer FAT as required.
* Provide support to the service team to resolve technical issues and snag lists.
* Co\-ordinate with Product Line for closure of technical issues in design, FAT \& SAS commission.
* Share Return of Experience across the team \& implement the applicable RoEs in design phase.
* Manage technical interface with sub suppliers \& partners.
* Technical support for project at ITO stage.
* Travel for customer visit / site if required.
* Adhere to all safe working procedures in accordance with EHS instructions.


**Time schedule \& On Time delivery**
* Participate with Engineering Leader / Project Manager and finalize deliverables and project plan
* Manage design time spent on relevant activities
* Ensure on\-time delivery of Quality design deliverables
* On weekly basis provide Team lead and /or PM with project reviews


**Project strategy, risk management, Process \& Tools**
* Follow project strategy \& highlight scope or design changes (data for claims, VO)
* Propose quality \& cost\-effective solutions.
* Track, manage \& mitigate identified or potential deviations / risks.
* Comply with GE Quality Procedures, work instructions and process for seamless project execution.
* Anticipate and mitigate delivery issues and recommend change


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical \& Electronics or Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Relevant field experience of 4 to 8 years in SAS Engineering/Commissioning.
* Independent to handle the project Engineering, Customer discussion/approvals, Test, validate \& troubleshoot the SAS products/system.
* Broad knowledge on Substation Automation System Engineering, Communication architecture, Industrial protocols like IEC 61850, Modbus, T104, Network concepts (Layer\-2 \&3\), Process bus based Digital Substation, Automation and control system standards and regulatory compliance.
* Experience to integrate IEDs of multiple vendors like Hitachi, Siemens, SE, SEL; DCS/Network Troubleshoot tools.
* Expertise in cybersecurity best practices and security hardening techniques for industrial control systems.
* Basic Knowledge on Engineering process, Protection, Commissioning of SAS systems, India region utility/industry practices and standards.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and responsive skills
* Ability to work independent \& Problem\-solving skills
* Proficient to Work with cross function teams.
* Collaboration and Teamwork; Innovation; Convince and Influence


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

title: Customer Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Domain Architect is responsible for defining and implementing the Core domain\-wide strategy for Application(Cloud network function) deployment automation and AI\-enabled Automation SW development and delivery across various Nokia blueprint as well as customized product teams. The role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Network function deployment automation frameworks, CI/CD ecosystems, and the application of AI capabilities to optimize development workstreams, operational efficiency and delivery velocity. The architect will drive scalable, maintainable automation solutions, enable self\-healing delivery pipelines, and mentor teams in modern DevOps and AI\-assisted SW engineering practices.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead requirement analysis, solution alignment, and end\-to\-end architecture activities, including HLD, LLD, CIQ validation and solution governance.
* Define migration strategies, provide technical leadership, and guide implementation activities across the complete migration lifecycle.
* Drive customization discussions, RCA execution, escalation management, and resolution of technical issues in collaboration with Care, R\&D and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and delivery readiness activities to ensure successful solution deployment and adoption.
* Promote innovation through automation, AI\-driven solutions, next\-generation delivery practices, and close collaboration with R\&D/Development team on product enhancements.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 10\+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.
* Exhibit extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containerized application deployments.
* Proven experience in defining Cloud\-native architectures and delivering those solutions to the market.
* Experience working effectively in global organizations, with strong communication, motivational and technical leadership skills.
* Prior design and application deployment experience in custom solution and applications products.


 Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* Telecom domain exposure (Packet Core, 4G/5G, network protocols, cloud\-native network functions) and Experience in implementing autonomous deployment platforms or AI\-driven operational automation.
* Knowledge of MLOps, AI platform operations and deployment of AI/ML workloads in cloud\-native environments and Certifications in cloud platforms or AI/ML specialties
